description: Runs any POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE operation from list_operations as the connected trainer, exactly as the app would: edit or archive workouts, assign programs, log or edit a session, create assessments, diet plans and check-ins, send chat messages, cancel or move classes, update the public page, and more. Same permissions, plan limits and validation as the app; a 422 lists what is missing. It can notify students (push, e-mail) and some operations cannot be undone, so confirm with the person first. Charges, refunds, payments, subscriptions, plans and prices, coupons, tabs, withdrawals, bank details, password and account deletion stay in the app.

body.description: JSON body with the fields from describe_operation.

path.description: Path with ids filled in, e.g. /v1/workouts/5216.

name: api_write
title: Do anything in Trainer Connect
